steps.action: C52 prerequisite: an Entity built by a clearly-labelled API fixture
steps.actual: API fixture created "Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY"; every reader step below is performed in the browser

steps.action: C52 guide steps 1-4: Add obligation saves a recurring schedule and a one-off
steps.actual: Add obligation saved "Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY" due 2025-09-30 repeating every 12 months and "Rev C52 one-off licence LRY0TDY" due 2026-11-20 with a blank recurrence, both assigned to Nadia Haddad

steps.action: C52 negative: an out-of-range recurrence and a blank Label are refused with a clear outcome
steps.actual: a 1,201-month recurrence kept the dialog open (Repeat every (months) One or more request fields are invalid.); a zero-month recurrence was refused the same way; a blank Label was refused and the dialog stayed open; no refused Obligation reached the Entity

steps.action: C52 guide step 5: an open Obligation's note saves on blur and its assignee saves on choice
steps.actual: Typing a note and moving focus away saved it; choosing Unassigned saved at once. Both survived a reload and the assignee was set back to Nadia Haddad

steps.action: C52 guide steps 1-4: the calendar lists overdue first, filters, and keeps them across Month
steps.actual: The due-date list led with overdue rows carrying the severe treatment (11 of 119 rows, none out of order); the Entity filter and Apply narrowed it to "Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY"; Month, Previous month, Next month, Today and Due-date list all kept that filter in the address

steps.action: C52 negative: reading the calendar and Home does not file or advance a past-due item
steps.actual: Home's Entity obligations section listed "Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY" as overdue and assigned to Nadia Haddad; after reading the calendar and Home its due date was still 2025-09-30 and it still offered Mark filed, so reading neither filed nor advanced it

steps.action: C52 guide steps 1-3: Mark filed advances a recurring cycle past the missed years
steps.actual: Mark filed opened with Filed on defaulting to 2026-09-08; filing the 2025-09-30 annual schedule on 2026-10-05 advanced it once past the missed cycle to 2027-09-30, exactly the guide's worked example

steps.action: C52 guide step 3: History records the filing and its cycle
steps.actual: History listed the filing against "Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY" (Nadia Haddad marked Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY filed on Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY | Nadia Haddad changed the obligation Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY on Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY)

steps.action: C52 guide step 4: a filed one-off keeps its due date, locks its row and refuses a second filing
steps.actual: Filing "Rev C52 one-off licence LRY0TDY" kept its due date at 2026-11-20, marked it Filed, disabled its row controls and withdrew Mark filed, so it cannot be filed again

steps.action: C52 guide step 2: Include completed brings the filed one-off back into the calendar
steps.actual: The filed one-off left the open results and came back once Include completed was turned on and applied

steps.action: C52 guide step 4: when no results match, the calendar offers Clear all
steps.actual: A 2035 window against "Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY" matched nothing and the calendar explained "Change or clear the filters to see other due dates."; Clear all dropped every filter from the address and returned the whole calendar

steps.action: C52 guide recovery: Delete removes an Obligation and its future schedule
steps.actual: "Delete Rev C52 disposable schedule LRY0TDY" removed that Obligation and its six-month schedule and left "Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY" untouched

steps.action: C52 negative: archiving the Entity takes its Obligations out of the calendar and Home
steps.actual: Archiving "Rev C52 entity LRY0TDY" removed "Rev C52 annual return LRY0TDY" from the compliance calendar and Home; Restore brought it back to the calendar
